item.name: Ghostwood Crook
item.description: A shepherd's crook carved from pale ghostwood. Livestock heed the fences it draws, though no one else can see them.
recipe.name: Ghostwood Crook
message.too-far: That's too far away to reach with the crook.
message.no-host-mod: The host doesn't have Ghostwood Crook installed, so phantom fences can't be changed.
message.limit: This area can't hold any more phantom fence.
message.overlay-off: Phantom fences: only visible with the Ghostwood Crook
config.price.name: Marnie's price
config.price.desc: Gold price of the Ghostwood Crook at Marnie's Ranch. Set to 0 to remove it from the shop.
config.recipe-enabled.name: Enable crafting recipe
config.recipe-enabled.desc: Adds a crafting recipe for the crook (learned automatically). Takes effect after returning to title or next day.
config.recipe-ingredients.name: Recipe ingredients
config.recipe-ingredients.desc: Ingredient list in game format: item ID, count, item ID, count... (e.g. '709 10 769 5' = 10 Hardwood + 5 Void Essence).
config.range.name: Reach (tiles)
config.range.desc: How many tiles away from the farmer you can place or remove phantom fence (1 = adjacent tiles, like tools).
config.drag.name: Drag to paint
config.drag.desc: Hold the use-tool button and move to paint (or erase) a line of phantom fence.
config.opacity.name: Overlay opacity
config.opacity.desc: How visible the ghostly fence overlay is while holding the crook.
config.toggle.name: Always-show toggle key
config.toggle.desc: Toggles showing phantom fences even when you're not holding the crook.
config.pets.name: Blocks pets
config.pets.desc: Whether phantom fences also stop cats, dogs, and other pets (host setting).
